about_short_description.short_description: Gracenote is an entertainment data and technology provider across Music, Video and Sports.

product.name: Gracenote Video Data
product.description: A global database of movie, television, and sports-program metadata, imagery, schedules, celebrity information, and streaming availability for entertainment discovery experiences.

product.name: Gracenote Audio Data
product.description: Metadata for music, artists, albums, tracks, radio, and podcasts, including genre, era, mood, tempo, imagery, and on-demand audio details.

product.name: Gracenote Sports Data
product.description: Sports metadata covering live scores, schedules, standings, teams, players, competitions, and related sports content across leagues and sports worldwide.

product.name: Gracenote IDs
product.description: Industry-standard identifiers that link programs, movies, music, sports, and other entertainment assets across platforms, catalogs, and distribution workflows.

product.name: Gracenote Content Distribution
product.description: Content distribution services that use Gracenote metadata, IDs, and a global network to register, enrich, and deliver program information to video platforms and services.

product.name: Gracenote Content Analytics
product.description: Analytics and insights for TV and movie catalogs that support data-driven content investment, programming, and portfolio decisions.
